mapper.insert: insert into message_chat ( message_no, message_sender_no, message_sender_name, message_sender_type ) values( #{messageNo}, #{messageSenderId}, #{messageSenderNickname}, #{messageSenderLevel} )
mapper.select: select M.*, C.message_sender_id, C.message_sender_nickname, C.message_sender_level, S.message_level from message M left outer join message_chat C on M.message_no = C.message_no left outer join message_system S on M.message_no = S.message_no where M.message_room = #{messageRoom} order by M.message_no desc
